title: Chlamydia
summary: See NICE CKS and BASHH guideline. If chlamydia infection is suspected or confirmed, strongly recommend referral to a genito-urinary medicine (GUM) clinic for management. Testing for asymptomatic chlamydia is also available via the online STI testing service (sh24.org.uk). If the person declines, or is unable to attend a GUM clinic, manage uncomplicated genital chlamydia infection in primary care.
